grid.size_basis: % of the venue ADV in instruments.json (one venue, NOT consolidated); size_pct_consolidated_adv is on each parent row from C:\Work\Claude\intraday-alpha-platform\wt-b8v2-run\research\execution\b8v2\consolidated_adv.json

inference.bootstrap: cluster bootstrap over sessions, 2000 draws, seeded
inference.se: cluster-robust sandwich of the per-parent mean (CR1), Student-t with G-1 df

pin_iex+capped.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

pin_nasdaq+capped.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

sor+capped.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

sor_sweep+capped.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

arrival_markout_bps.arrival_price: mid at the parent window start
arrival_markout_bps.benchmark: side-signed fill price minus arrival mid, quantity-weighted
arrival_markout_bps.sign: positive = worse (paid above / sold below arrival)

completion_charge_bps.arrival_price: mid at the parent window start
completion_charge_bps.benchmark: half-spread at the window end + taker fee, per residual share
completion_charge_bps.unit: bps of the arrival mid of the residual

completion_ratio.denominator: number of parents (filled == target counts as complete)

cost_per_filled_share_bps.arrival_price: mid at the parent window start (decision = arrival)
cost_per_filled_share_bps.benchmark: arrival mid; trading cost + net fees + simulated impact adder
cost_per_filled_share_bps.denominator: filled shares x arrival mid (sum over parents for the pooled ratio)
cost_per_filled_share_bps.target_qty: parent qty; only the FILLED quantity enters

fill_rate.denominator: sum of parent target qty (qty-weighted); per-parent distribution beside it
fill_rate.sign: higher = more of the target traded

post_trade_markout_bps.benchmark: side-signed (fill price - mid at fill + h), quantity-weighted
post_trade_markout_bps.denominator: filled shares with a defined mid at +h (undefined fills are excluded, never zero)
post_trade_markout_bps.horizon: per horizon h after each fill (1s, 5s, 30s)
post_trade_markout_bps.sign: positive = worse (the price moved against the fill: adverse selection)

residual_qty.denominator: none (sum; mean per parent beside it)

shortfall_per_target_share_bps.arrival_price: mid at the parent window start
shortfall_per_target_share_bps.horizon: window end (opportunity cost marks the residual at the end mid)
shortfall_per_target_share_bps.unit: bps of the arrival notional of the TARGET

trading_cost_per_filled_share_bps.arrival_price: mid at the parent window start
trading_cost_per_filled_share_bps.benchmark: Perold trading cost of the filled quantity (fill price vs arrival mid)

pin_iex+capped-pin_nasdaq+capped.sign: other - base; positive = the policy is worse, except fill_rate (positive = the policy fills more)

sor+capped-pin_nasdaq+capped.sign: other - base; positive = the policy is worse, except fill_rate (positive = the policy fills more)

sor_sweep+capped-pin_nasdaq+capped.sign: other - base; positive = the policy is worse, except fill_rate (positive = the policy fills more)

simulator.cost_label: replay + fitted adder (rule 6b, exponent 1, fit support unknown)
simulator.note: costs are replay + adder: simulated fills never move the replayed book

two_venue.alignment: both streams on ns since the session's New York midnight, exchange (UTC) clock; Nasdaq ITCH as stamped; IEX: exchange_ts from the messages' own UTC send times (iex_clock='exchange', no shift) or, for a capture-clock (TAI) stream, exchange_ts/receive_ts - 37 s (iex_clock='capture'); merge order (exchange_ts, venue_id), each stream's own order kept inside a tie
two_venue.feed_latency_skew_note: feed latency = capture-host packet time minus IEX send time: an unidentified clock offset is included, only within-capture differences are interpretable, cross-venue skew against Nasdaq stamps from another host is not identified, and none of it is a trading advantage or an order-entry latency (iap.marketdata.iex.CAPTURE_TS_PROVENANCE)
